notes.content: 2026-07-15 (Opus verification pass): fixed. Verified against samm.f90 provisional layout that BOTH the extract index (igamma+1 -> igamma-1, l.1186) AND the shift-loop bound (igamma -> igamma-1, l.1188) are off-by-one; fixing only the extract still corrupts the last explicit channel. End-to-end LRF=7 eval check remains under op-cjw.2.

description: Issue #30 comment 2026-08-22 03:05 UTC: 'I want to be able to scroll freely and annotate the pdf just like okular.' Free scroll already exists (egui::ScrollArea::both in pdf_reader.rs). Annotation does not exist at all. This is the largest of the fresh follow-up items -- needs a scoping/design pass before implementation: at minimum, per-page highlight rectangles + text notes drawn as an overlay on the rasterized page texture, held in PdfReaderState, with an open question on persistence (in-memory only for a first cut vs. a sidecar file living next to the PDF, which also touches the not-yet-built 'kovan folder' project format in op-63u0/op-b1y5). Do not conflate with the draw-box-then-digitise interaction (op-p17q/op-hnhp) -- that is a *tool selection* over the same canvas, not a saved annotation.

acceptance_criteria: Written derivation of the ill-conditioning stability criterion + [50,100] kg/m3 taper justification, ready for paper methods.
description: By-hand analytical derivation/justification of the rarefied-tail density taper that stabilised the full 600ms hybrid run (op-21g.15.7). Author's own derivation for the paper methods (Phase II row C of the Edwards debug timeline table, index.tex). Derive: (1) analytically why the explicit KNP correction is ill-conditioned as rho -> 0 -- the cell diagonal rho_cont*V/dt collapses, so a fixed explicit flux correction produces an unbounded enthalpy update (the stability criterion motivating the taper); show how a rarefied cell enthalpy diverges and trips the (p,h) 273.15K validity edge; (2) justify the taper g(rho) = clamp((rho-50)/(100-50),0,1) -- below 50 kg/m3 there is no flashing shock left to capture so switching KNP off costs no accuracy, and the taper is inert above 100 kg/m3 so it does not perturb the validated plateau (bit-identical ringing reduction and plateau).
title: Derive by hand: rarefied-tail density taper for HybridAllMach stability (for paper methods)
